LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RestartNote: Changes in this section take effect after a restart. Turning vehicles off is safe for a running colony: their added parts are dropped when the save loads.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ScopeAllVehicles: Every vehicle with a fitting design
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ScopeAllVehiclesDes: Every vehicle from any mod gets batteries, coolant, oil, tyres, brakes and the rest, by what it runs on and whether it drives, floats or flies.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ScopePhobosOnlyDesc: Other mods' vehicles stay exactly as their authors made them.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingFullForEvery: Every faction's vehicles run the full model

Off by default: only your own vehicles run every system in full. Other factions' vehicles on your map take hits and keep what they are given, but nothing in them heats, wears or runs down on its own, which keeps a raid's vehicles cheap. On: raiders' and visitors' vehicles overheat, leak and run dry exactly as yours do, at the same cost each.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingShowOnlyDesc: The systems run and show their state, but nothing happens to the vehicles: no wear, failures, refusals or slowing. Messages still tell you what would have happened.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingFuelGellingD: Below about -8 °C chemfuel behaves like diesel and gels: a cold vehicle will not start until it is warmer, in a heated room or on a warmer day. Off by default, because nothing says chemfuel is diesel.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SectionRemove: Removing vehicle systems from a colony
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DrivetrainOffDesc: No gears, engine speed or traction. Engine load stays the simple moving-or-idling figure the other systems used before.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DrivetrainDisplayOn: Vehicles show their gear, engine speed and load, and heat and charge follow them, but no vehicle is ever slowed by its engine, its weight or the ground.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DrivetrainFullDesc: As above, and a vehicle slows where its engine runs out of power (heavy loads, steep or soft ground) or its wheels run out of grip. A vehicle that cannot grip crawls on at a fraction of its speed rather than stopping.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingLoadFuelDesc: Off by default: vehicles burn fuel at the rate their authors set. On: a laden vehicle climbing through sand burns more, an empty one on a road less, and an idling engine burns a little while parked. At an ordinary cruise the rate matches the author's.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingNightHeaterD: Off by default: a caravan's vehicles shut their engines down at the night camp, and their cabs cool to the night air. On: a vehicle whose night heater switch is on burns a little fuel through the night to keep its cab and its engine warm, as trucks' parking heaters do, so it starts easily in the morning. Switch each vehicle's night heater on before the caravan leaves.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingAccessoryLoa: On by default: lights, heaters and climate control take their power from the engine through the alternator, so the engine runs a little warmer for them, and burns a little more fuel when fuel follows the engine's load. Off: they cost the engine nothing.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingRoughGround: Rough ground wears tyres and suspension
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingRoughGroundD: On by default: driving over rough ground wears tyres, tracks and suspension faster than a road does, up to three times as fast on the worst ground a vehicle can cross, so roads save repairs. Off: they wear by distance alone, wherever the vehicle drives.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingRawServices: This colony: services take raw materials instead of kits
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingRawServicesD: Saved with this colony, not for every game. Off: a vehicle's tyres, brakes and engine service, and a new drive belt, need a kit made at the vehicle parts bench and loaded aboard, so caravans carry kits. On: they take the steel, components and chemfuel the kits are made of, as before. A colony started before kits existed begins with this on, so no service already due is held up; switch it off once you have kits. A new colony begins with it off.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingLowOilServic: Low oil calls for a service

On by default: when an engine's oil falls below 60%, its service falls due at once, and a mechanic tops it up. A worn engine burns oil faster, so it comes due sooner than its hour meter says. Off: burned oil only lowers the level until the next service, and an engine left low loses oil pressure and wears.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingHoverLimit: When an aircraft is too heavy or too hot to lift off or hover onto its pad
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HoverRefusePadUseRu: Refuse it: use the runway, or lighten it (default)

A jump jet whose engine cannot hold it in a hover, because it is heavily laden or the day is hot, lands on a runway like an ordinary jet. An order to land on the pad is refused with the reason. A helicopter or a thrust-lifted pod whose engines cannot lift it, because it is laden, the day is hot or engines are out, will not launch until it is lightened, repaired or the air cools.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HoverAllowWithDamag: Allow it, at a cost to the engine
The landing or lift-off goes ahead with the engines run past their limits: they wear and you are told.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HoverWarnOnly: Allow it, with a warning only
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HoverWarnOnlyDesc: The landing or lift-off goes ahead as the aircraft's own mod allows, and a message says it was beyond the engines.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingRealisticFee: Off by default: a water stop draws a tenth of a locomotive's real tender or tank capacity, so a 4-8-4's refill fits in one Dubs Bad Hygiene water tower. On: it draws the real figure, 68,000 litres for the big 4-8-4, which needs several towers or a huge one.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingBoilerExplos: Off by default. On: a boiler without a fusible plug (the American 4-8-4) whose water falls below the firebox crown with the fire lit explodes, wrecking the boiler and hurting everything nearby. Boilers with a plug still only vent.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_BoilerExplosionsWar: Warning: an exploding boiler can kill the crew and anyone nearby and wreck what stands around it, without a second chance. Watch the water glass, and give it water stops in time.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingBatteryFires: Off by default. On: an electric vehicle's traction battery that overheats past the point of no return (from damage, or from being driven hard while already overheating) catches fire and bursts, wrecking the battery and burning what stands nearby. Off: it still overheats, loses power and takes damage, but never burns.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_BatteryFiresWarning: Warning: a burning battery can set the vehicle, its crew and the buildings around it alight. Keep damaged electric vehicles away from your base until the battery has cooled.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingElectricLigh: The Lightning runs on batteries (needs a restart)

Off by default. On, with D'thorga Vehicles and Vanilla Vehicles Expanded - Tier 3: the Lightning becomes an electric van, to try the electric vehicle systems. It charges from a powered network with stored energy (about five batteries' worth for a full charge) instead of taking chemfuel, and keeps its range. Takes effect when the game next starts. Lightnings already built keep the chemfuel in their tanks as charge.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingJumpStartNee: On by default: a jump-start needs a jump-start kit, in stock on the map (the helper fetches it) or aboard the caravan. Craft one at a machining table or a fabrication bench; it is never used up. Off: the leads are free, as before.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingAssumeBooste: Every vehicle carries a booster pack

Off by default: a jump-start needs another vehicle near enough (or in the same caravan) with charge to give, or a crafted booster pack with a start left, so a lone vehicle with a flat battery and no pack waits for help. On: every vehicle is taken to carry a charged booster pack, and a jump-start needs no other vehicle and no pack, on the map or in a caravan.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RemoveExplain: Vehicles save their parts in order, so a save made with these systems cannot simply lose them. Before you remove D'thorga Framework or Vehicle Framework from a colony, load it, press this button, save, then remove the mod. Turning vehicles or systems off above needs none of this.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RemoveButton: Remove the added parts from this colony's vehicles
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RemoveConfirm: Remove every part the vehicle systems added, from every vehicle in this colony, and stop the systems until you restart? Save straight afterwards, then remove the mod.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RemoveDone: Done. Save now, then remove the mod. The systems stay stopped until you restart.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RemoveResult: The added parts were removed from {COUNT} vehicles. Save now, then remove the mod.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RequestServiceDesc: Have a mechanic service this vehicle as soon as they can, even if nothing is due yet. Haulers first load the supplies each service needs into its cargo; then a constructor does the work. The vehicle must be parked and not in use.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_LoadDraw: Draws {AMPS} A from the battery or the alternator while it runs.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_InspectEngineer: Engine load {LOAD}, electrical draw {AMPS} A, air {AIR}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_InspectPower: Load {LOAD}: engine {ENGINE} kW, fuel {FUEL} kW, heat {HEAT} kW.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_WaterNoPlumbing: park it over or against a plumbing pipe with a water tower on it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_WaterTowersEmpty: the water towers on the pipe beside it are nearly empty.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseFlatBattery: The {VEHICLE}'s battery is too weak to start the engine. Have a colonist jump-start it from another vehicle parked near it, park it beside a powered conduit or battery to charge, or warm it: a cold battery gives less.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseStarter: The {VEHICLE}'s starter motor is broken. Repair the vehicle to start it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DashEngineDesc: Starts or stops the engine. A vehicle that is set up can run its engine but cannot be driven.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DashCheckEngine: Check engine: it is at {HEALTH} health.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseFuelPump: The {VEHICLE}'s fuel pump is ruined. Repair it before starting the engine.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseFuelGelled: The {VEHICLE}'s fuel has thickened in the cold. Warm the vehicle in a heated room, or wait for a warmer day.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseBrakesWorn: The {VEHICLE}'s brakes are worn through. A mechanic must fit new pads before it drives.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseBrakesWrecked: The {VEHICLE}'s brakes are wrecked. Repair the vehicle before it drives.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseAirBrakes: The {VEHICLE}'s air brakes are still held on. Leave the engine running a few minutes to build air pressure.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseLiftOff: The {VEHICLE}'s engines cannot lift it as it is: too heavy for this heat, or with engines out. Unload some cargo or passengers, repair its engines, or wait for cooler air.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseRaisingSteam: The {VEHICLE} has too little steam to move. Keep it drafted with its fire lit until the boiler is up to pressure: from cold that takes hours.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefusePlugMelted: The {VEHICLE}'s fusible plug has melted and its boiler is vented. A mechanic must fit a new plug before it can raise steam again.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseHungStart: The {VEHICLE}'s battery cannot spin its turbine fast enough to light. Have a colonist jump-start it from another vehicle parked near it, or charge the battery beside a powered conduit.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgBatteryFreezing: The {VEHICLE}'s flat battery is freezing and may crack. Charge it or move it somewhere warmer.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgOverheating: The {VEHICLE}'s engine is overheating and taking damage. Stop it and let it cool.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgCoolantLow: The {VEHICLE} is low on coolant. A service will top it up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgOilLow: The {VEHICLE} is low on oil. A service will top it up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgOilPressureGone: The {VEHICLE} has no oil pressure. Stop the engine now: it will seize.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgOilPressureLow: The {VEHICLE}'s oil pressure is low; the engine wears while it runs.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgServiceDue: The {VEHICLE} is due for a service.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgServiceOverdue: The {VEHICLE} is overdue for a service; its parts are failing more often.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTyresWorn: The {VEHICLE}'s tyres or tracks are worn.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTyreFailed: The {VEHICLE}'s worn-out {PART} has failed on the move.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgBrakesWorn: The {VEHICLE}'s brakes are worn; its driver is taking it gently.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTransmissionHot: The {VEHICLE}'s gearbox is overheating and wearing as it drives.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHydraulicsLow: The {VEHICLE} is low on hydraulic fluid.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTurbineHot: The {VEHICLE}'s turbine is running past its continuous limit; its hot section is wearing fast.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTurbineOverTop: The {VEHICLE}'s turbine is past every limit and taking damage. Ease off or land.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHotSectionWorn: The {VEHICLE}'s turbine hot section is worn out and may fail. A mechanic should overhaul it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHotStart: The {VEHICLE}'s weak battery lit its turbine hot, wearing the hot section. A jump-start gives a clean start.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgInjectionWaterOu: The {VEHICLE} has used its injection water; its engine is back to its dry limits until a mechanic refills the tank.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgLiftStrained: The {VEHICLE} lifted off beyond its engines' limits, and they took the strain.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgLiftBeyond: The {VEHICLE} lifted off beyond what its engines can carry at this weight in this heat.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgOverTorque: The {VEHICLE}'s rotor drive is being asked for more than it can take, and is wearing. Lighten it or ease off.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTractionBatteryC: The {VEHICLE}'s traction battery is too cold to give its full power, and it takes charge only slowly until it warms.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTractionBatteryH: The {VEHICLE}'s traction battery is running hot. It gives less power and charges slowly.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTractionBatteryO: The {VEHICLE}'s traction battery is overheating and damaging itself. Stop driving it and let it cool.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTractionBatteryR: The {VEHICLE}'s traction battery has gone into thermal runaway. Keep everyone away from it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTractionBatteryW: The {VEHICLE}'s traction battery has worn and holds noticeably less charge. New battery modules would restore it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseTractionBatte: The {VEHICLE}'s traction battery is in thermal runaway.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgMotorHot: The {VEHICLE}'s motor is running hot and holding back its power.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgMotorOverheating: The {VEHICLE}'s motor is overheating and burning its windings. Stop and let it cool, and repair it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTractionMotorsHo: The {VEHICLE}'s traction motors are running hot from hard pulling.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTractionMotorsOv: The {VEHICLE}'s traction motors are overheating and burning their windings. Ease the load and let them cool.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgBoilerWaterLow: The {VEHICLE}'s boiler water is low. Keep its feed water topped up, or the fire will burn the crown sheet dry.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgFeedWaterLow: The {VEHICLE} is nearly out of feed water. It needs a water stop soon.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHoverRefused: The {VEHICLE} is too heavy for its engine to hover onto the pad in this heat. Land it on a runway, or lighten it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHoverStrained: The {VEHICLE} is hovering beyond its engine's limits; its hot section is taking the strain.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHoverBeyond: The {VEHICLE} is hovering beyond what its engine can hold at this weight in this heat.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoDo: Cannot jump-start the {VEHICLE}: no vehicle with a charged battery or a running engine is within {REACH} cells, and there is no booster pack with a start left. Park one beside it, or bring a charged booster pack.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoPa: Cannot jump-start the {VEHICLE}: there is nowhere to stand beside it that can be reached.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_JumpStarted: {HELPER} has jump-started the {VEHICLE} from the {DONOR}. It will start now; drive it to charge the battery.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_JumpStartFailed: {HELPER} could not jump-start the {VEHICLE}: the {DONOR} has too little charge left or has moved away.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_JumpStartOptionBoos: Jump-start the {VEHICLE} from its booster pack
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_JumpStartedBooster: {HELPER} has jump-started the {VEHICLE} from its booster pack. It will start now; drive it to charge the battery.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoKi: Cannot jump-start the {VEHICLE}: there is no jump-start kit to fetch for the leads, and no booster pack with a start left. Craft a kit at a machining table or a fabrication bench.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_JumpStartOptionPack: Jump-start the {VEHICLE} with a booster pack
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_JumpStartedPack: {HELPER} has jump-started the {VEHICLE} with a booster pack, which has {COUNT} starts left. It will start now; drive it to charge the battery.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CaravanJumpStartDes: A crew member connects the {VEHICLE} and cranks it. The charge comes from another vehicle through the leads, or from a booster pack.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoKi: No jump-start kit in the caravan to connect the {VEHICLE} with, and no booster pack aboard with a start left.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoDo: No other vehicle in the caravan has the charge to give the {VEHICLE}, and no booster pack aboard has a start left.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoHe: Nobody in the caravan is able to jump-start the {VEHICLE}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CaravanCapExplanati: {VEHICLE} held to {CAP} of its speed by its engine or the ground
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneEmptyMassDesc: The vehicle's weight with no cargo, crew or fuel, in kilograms. Cargo, passengers, hills and soft ground work the engine against this, and the engine's power follows it unless the vehicle has a power of its own.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneBatteryAmpHours: How much charge the starting battery holds. A typical car battery is about 45; a heavy vehicle's pair about 100.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneAlternatorAmpsD: What the alternator gives while the engine runs, before the lights and heater take their share.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneStarterAmpHours: What each start takes from the battery in mild weather; more in the cold.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneEngineHeat: Engine heat at full load (°C an hour)
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneEngineHeatDesc: How fast the engine heats its coolant while driving. Higher runs hotter.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneRadiatorRateDes: How strongly the radiator pulls the coolant toward the air once the thermostat opens. Higher runs cooler.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneThermostatDesc: The coolant temperature at which the radiator starts working. Real thermostats open at about 82 to 90.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneOilBurn: Oil burned (share an hour at full load)
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneOilBurnDesc: How fast the engine uses its oil. Lower means fewer top-ups between services.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneTreadWear: Tyre and track wear (share an hour moving)
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneTreadWearDesc: How fast tyres or track pads wear on the move. At 0.0025 they are worn after about 240 hours of driving.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneGearboxHeat: Gearbox heat at full load (°C an hour)
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneGearboxHeatDesc: How fast hard driving heats the gearbox's oil.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneCompressorDesc: How fast the engine builds air for the air brakes. Only trucks with air brakes use it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneAirLeakDesc: How fast a parked truck loses its brake air. Only trucks with air brakes use it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RepairStalled: The repairs to the {VEHICLE} were getting nowhere, so the mechanic has stopped. They will be tried again tomorrow.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RepairPausedLine: Repairs got nowhere, and will be tried again tomorrow.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RepairWaitingMechan: {WORK}: everything is aboard, waiting for a mechanic.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RepairNeedsOr: {WORK}: needs {SUPPLIES} in its cargo, or one of these instead: {OTHERS}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RepairFieldFixed: {MECHANIC} patched the {PART} on the {VEHICLE}. It will hold for now, until it is properly repaired.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RequestFieldFixDesc: Have a mechanic patch this vehicle's leaks and shorts with a component from its cargo. A patch slows the damage so it can limp home; it does not repair the part, and it can only be done once.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CaravanRepairMoving: The caravan has to stop first.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CaravanRepairNoMech: Nobody in the caravan can do construction work.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingDestroyedPar: A part at 0% needs supplies in the vehicle's cargo and a mechanic before ordinary repair can continue. Damaged parts are still mended for free. Applies to your own vehicles, from any mod.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingWholePartSha: Replacing an engine or transmission costs: {SHARE}
At 100%, the whole part. Below that, this share of the materials the part is made from. At 0%, nothing.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingOtherPartSha: This share of the full materials for the part. At 0%, nothing.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingEnemyFitSets: Some vehicles of other factions are found with fittings and a tune suited to their faction, and keep them if captured.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ButtonFittingsDesc: Choose what is bolted onto this vehicle's parts and how its engine is set up. A mechanic does the work.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_FitWindowIntro: A fitting goes on one part, one to a part, and is lost if that part is destroyed. A tune sets up the whole engine. A part's grade sets how tough and how reliable it is, and changing it on a working part uses up the old one. Materials are brought to the vehicle, then a mechanic does the work.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_FitNoTunes: This vehicle's engine has nothing to tune.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_FitNoParts: Nothing on this vehicle can take a fitting.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_UpgradeNeedsResearc: This upgrade needs {RESEARCH} to be researched first.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_FitPartDestroyed: the part must be replaced first
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_FitOrderLost: {WORK} on the {VEHICLE} was abandoned: the part is gone.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_FitGradeHoldsNone: a {GRADE} part cannot hold a fitting
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingFieldFixesDe: Colonists can patch leaks and shorts away from a base, using a component.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HealthFeedsNoStat: Its damage slows nothing by itself.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingKeepVfHealth: Keep Vehicle Framework's own Health tab (needs a restart)

Off by default: vehicles with systems get this mod's Health tab in Vehicle Framework's place, with the parts grouped outside and inside, what each part does to the vehicle's speed and strength, and the conditions under each part. On: Vehicle Framework's own list stays. Takes effect when the game next starts.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DashLiteModel: This vehicle is not yours: its systems are not followed closely.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SysFlowToward: toward {TARGET} at {RATE} of the gap an hour
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SysCap: Held to {CAP} of its speed by {LIMIT}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SysBleed: Bleed air: the engine works {SHARE} harder for the same thrust (puffer jets, cabin heat)
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HoverWet: can hover only with water injection
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingCabMoodsDesc: On by default: people aboard a vehicle with a closed cab are glad of a warm cab in the cold or a cool one in the heat, and unhappy in a cab that is too cold or too hot for them, by their own comfortable range. Off: no such moods.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingClimateAll: Every closed cab has climate control
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingClimateAllDe: Off by default: automatic climate control comes only on vehicles built with it (modern ones; the switch shows on those). On: every vehicle with a closed cab has it, and holds its cab near 21 °C by itself while the engine runs.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_LetterBoilingText: The {VEHICLE}'s coolant is boiling away and the engine is cooking itself.\n\nStop the vehicle now. Once it has cooled, repair the radiator and have a mechanic service it to refill the coolant.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_LetterPlugMeltedTex: The water in the {VEHICLE}'s boiler fell below the firebox crown. The lead plug in the crown melted and blew steam onto the fire, venting the boiler before the crown sheet could fail.\n\nIt cannot raise steam again until a mechanic fits a new plug. Give it feed water at a water stop before you light it again.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_LetterBoilerExplode: The water in the {VEHICLE}'s boiler fell below the firebox crown while the fire burned. With no fusible plug to vent it, the dry crown sheet softened and tore, and the boiler's water flashed to steam all at once.\n\nThe boiler is wrecked. Tend the wounded; repair the boiler before it can steam again, and keep its water up next time.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingTuningNeedsR: Tunes and changes of grade need a tuning rig

An engine or gearing tune, or changing a working part for one of another grade, waits until the vehicle is parked within reach of a working tuning rig. Fittings and replacing a destroyed part can still be done anywhere. Turn this off to work them anywhere.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RepairNeedsRig: {WORK}: waiting to be parked within {CELLS} cells of a working tuning rig.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_FitNoRigNote: This vehicle is not within {CELLS} cells of a working tuning rig, so tunes and changes of grade will wait until it is.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigInspectOff: Without power it can tune nothing.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DiagnoseDesc: Have a mechanic look this vehicle over at a tuning rig: every part, its grade and fitting, the tunes, every reading and every fault, in one report. Worth doing to a vehicle you have just captured or bought. The vehicle must stand within reach of a working tuning rig.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DiagnoseNeedsRig: {VEHICLE} waits to stand within reach of a working tuning rig.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DiagnoseIntro: {MECHANIC} has looked {VEHICLE} over at the rig.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DiagnosePower: Its engine is built to give {KW} kW.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DashSparklineTip: {QUANTITY} over the last {HOURS} hours. Open the Systems tab for the full graph.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ReportCannotJump: {VEHICLE} cannot be found on any map you can see now.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ReportCloseDesc: Mark the report read. It stays in the letter archive, where it opens the same way.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HydraulicsDry: {VEHICLE} has too little hydraulic fluid left to work. A mechanic's hydraulic top-up refills it; mend the leaking lines first, or it drains again.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenSetUpRefusal: {VEHICLE} is set up, with its cable out. Pack it up first.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenNotOnMap: It must be on a map to set up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenStopFirst: {VEHICLE} is still moving. Stop it first.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenNoCell: The cable end cannot go there. It needs clear, open ground beside the truck, or within the cable's reach, and no conduit on the same spot.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenSetUp: {VEHICLE} is set up and feeding the grid.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenCableLost: {VEHICLE} has lost its cable end, and has stopped feeding the grid.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenPartDead: Making no power: the {PART} is destroyed.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenNoFuel: Making no power: the tank is empty.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenTooDamaged: Making no power: the generator is too badly damaged.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenOutputLine: Feeding the grid: {WATTS} W on offer, working at {LOAD}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenGizmoSetUpDesc: Lower the outriggers and run out the cable. The engine then feeds the grid, using fuel in step with what the grid draws. It cannot move while set up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GenGizmoPackUpDesc: Take in the cable and raise the outriggers. Anything running on this truck loses its power.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_BayGizmoAssignDesc: Choose the one vehicle this bay is home to.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_BayAssigned: This bay is now home to {VEHICLE}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_BayGizmoGoDesc: Drive to this vehicle's home bay. It stops and switches off when it arrives.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_BayNoDriver: {VEHICLE} has nobody aboard who can drive it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_BayCannotReach: {VEHICLE} cannot find a way to its bay.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_BayWrongFuel: {VEHICLE} runs on a fuel this tank does not hold.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigNotOnMap: It must be on a map to set up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigStopFirst: {VEHICLE} is still moving. Stop it first.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigControls: The controls are too damaged to set up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigWorkControls: The controls are too damaged to work it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigPartGone: It cannot work: the {PART} is destroyed.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigSetUp: {VEHICLE} is set up and ready for a colonist to work it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigSetUpRefusal: {VEHICLE} is set up. Pack it up first.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyGizmoSetUpDes: Lower the outriggers and raise the sensor boom. A colonist with Intellectual work then runs the survey and looks for deep ore under this map. It cannot move while set up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyGizmoPackUpDe: Stow the boom and raise the outriggers, ready to drive.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyRoofed: The boom cannot be raised under a roof.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyNoBedrock: There is no bedrock here to survey.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyNoPower: The survey has stopped: there is no fuel and the battery is low.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyArrayRechargi: Battery low: the array has stopped while the engine recharges it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyArrayNoPower: Nothing to power the array: plug in, or fit the large battery. Surveying at the standard rate.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyRecharging: Engine idling to recharge the battery.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyDeepLine: Surveying for deep ore under this map.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyNoGround: The survey found nowhere on this map that could hold a deposit.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyFoundText: {FINDER_labelShort} has found a deposit of {ORE} deep under this map. A drill can bring it up. Select the set-up survey truck to see it on the ground.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyGizmoLongRang: Search nearby lands for one ore instead of the ground under this map. A find becomes a place to travel to.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SurveyGizmoTargetDe: Choose which ore the long-range search looks for.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigGizmoSetUpDesc: Lower the outriggers and raise the mast. A colonist with Mining work then drills at the hole behind the truck, and what comes up lands beside it. It cannot move while set up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigGizmoPackUpDesc: Lower the mast and raise the outriggers, ready to drive. Work on the current portion is lost.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigNoHole: There is no room behind the truck for the hole.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigNothingToDrill: There is nothing to drill here: no ore in reach and no bedrock.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigSpent: The ground here is spent: only stone comes up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigSpentNothing: The ground here is spent, and there is no bedrock to work.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigProgressOre: Drilling: {PROGRESS} of the way to the next portion.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigProgressStone: Drilling stone only: {PROGRESS} of the way to the next portion.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigInsectsText: The drilling at {VEHICLE} has broken into a tunnel, and insects are coming up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RigBufferFull: The liquid buffer is full. Park a tanker beside the rig set to load, or lay a pipe to it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_WellNoConsole: Oil is here, but a working resource console is needed to site a well.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_WellNoScanner: Deep oil is here, but it takes a powered ground-penetrating scanner or a set-up survey truck to site a well.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_WellNoSteel: Sinking a well needs steel in the rig's cargo.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_WellProgress: Sinking a well: {STEPS} of {TOTAL} lengths of casing.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_WellDone: {VEHICLE} has finished the well. Build a derrick over the well head to pump it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GroundwaterLine: Best water nearby is marked: {VALUE} in the shallow and deep layers together.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GroundwaterNone: No water under the ground within reach.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TipGizmoDesc: Raise the body and tip everything in the cargo onto the ground behind the truck, inside the outlined area. It cannot move while it tips. Whatever will not fit stays aboard.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TipNotOnMap: It can only tip on a map.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TipEmpty: There is nothing aboard to tip.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TipStopFirst: {VEHICLE} is still moving. Stop it first.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TipNoDriver: {VEHICLE} needs a driver aboard to work the body.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TipNoFuel: The engine has no fuel to lift the body.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TipControls: The body will not lift: the tip controls are wrecked.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TipFull: The ground behind it is full. {COUNT} stacks stay aboard.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TipStopped: The body has come down: the engine or the controls have failed.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_OverdriveGizmoDesc: Run the work at {FACTOR} times the pace. The engine runs flat out, fuel goes {FUEL} times as fast, and the working parts wear while it works. It switches itself off when a working part falls to half health or the engine overheats.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_OverdriveOff: {VEHICLE} is back to its normal pace.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_OverdriveWorn: A working part is too worn for overdrive. Repair it first.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_OverdriveStoppedWor: {VEHICLE} has dropped out of overdrive: a working part is down to half health.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_OverdriveStoppedHot: {VEHICLE} has dropped out of overdrive: the engine is overheating.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_OverdriveLine: Overdrive: working flat out, parts wearing.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_PartNoRoom: The {PART} has no room to swing out on either side. Move the truck clear of walls, buildings and other vehicles.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingPowerPointLa: Power points have the larger socket
A matter of looks only. Which picture a working truck's power point uses. Applies to the next one a truck sets out.
